snippet.title: Slime in the Ice Machine | Teaser Trailer | Gamflix
snippet.description:
In your dying dad's strip-mall cantina, you find a psychotropic slime tunnel to the world's greatest dives. Each new bar has a surreal crisis to solve: kick open doors to places you don't belong, entangle yourself with strangers, and master practical vices such as vandalism, seduction, & journalism.

Minimum:
OS: Windows 10 64-bit
Processor: Intel Core i5-4000 series or AMD equivalent
Memory: 4 GB RAM
Graphics: Intel HD 4000 / NVIDIA GeForce 700 series or equivalent (1GB VRAM
DirectX: Version 11
Storage: 5 GB available space
Sound Card: Any DirectX-compatible

Minimum:
OS: macOS 11.0 (Big Sur)
Processor: Intel Core i5 or Apple M1
Memory: 5 GB RAM
Graphics: Intel Iris or Apple integrated GPU
Storage: 5 GB available space
Sound Card: Apple M-series integrated GPU
